title: ranunculus cantoniensis subsp. sieboldii
intro: Ranunculus cantoniensis subsp. sieboldii, commonly known as Siebold's Buttercup, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote digestion, relieve nausea, and reduce fever. The health benefits of Siebold's Buttercup include its ability to calm the stomach, relieve constipation, and alleviate symptoms of the common cold. The therapeutic actions of this plant can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may help to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune system.
